```plato

    //==
    // # Distance metrics

    // The distance between two planar offsets under the chosen Worley metric.
    // Minkowski is the p = 3 member of the family, the usual stand-in for the
    // "rounded Manhattan" look.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minkowski_distance
    WorleyLength(d: Vector2D, metric: WorleyDistance): Number
        => match (metric) {
            Euclidean => d.Length;
            Manhattan => d.X.Abs + d.Y.Abs;
            Chebyshev => d.X.Abs.Max(d.Y.Abs);
            Minkowski => (d.X.Abs.Pow(3.0) + d.Y.Abs.Pow(3.0)).Pow(1.0 / 3.0);
        };
```

```plato
    // The distance between two spatial offsets under the chosen Worley metric.
    WorleyLength(d: Vector3D, metric: WorleyDistance): Number
        => match (metric) {
            Euclidean => d.Length;
            Manhattan => d.X.Abs + d.Y.Abs + d.Z.Abs;
            Chebyshev => d.X.Abs.Max(d.Y.Abs).Max(d.Z.Abs);
            Minkowski => (d.X.Abs.Pow(3.0) + d.Y.Abs.Pow(3.0) + d.Z.Abs.Pow(3.0)).Pow(1.0 / 3.0);
        };
```
